title: Mark: A 6-Week Devotional
description: 41 short readings that walk through the whole Gospel of Mark in order, each with a theme and reflection questions.

days.title: How to experience true change
days.summary: Confession admits sin, repentance turns from it, and the Spirit helps us change.
reflectionQuestions: What have you planned that needs action?
Is there a sin you keep confessing but not overcoming?
Is Jesus in control of your life?

days.title: Why baptism matters for you
days.summary: Jesus's baptism was obedience and public identification; baptism declares our faith.
reflectionQuestions: Have you been baptized since trusting Jesus?
If not, what's holding you back?
What is God asking of you today?

days.title: Do you want to be closer to Jesus?
days.summary: The first disciples left their nets at once; respond to Jesus's call right away.
reflectionQuestions: What holds you back from following Jesus fully?
How can you look for Jesus more during your day?

days.title: Do you see Jesus as a healer?
days.summary: Healing follows as people recognize Jesus's authority and believe.
reflectionQuestions: Who is your authority on right and wrong?
Have you submitted your life to Jesus as Lord?

days.title: Why does time with Jesus matter?
days.summary: Jesus withdraws to pray; time in prayer and Scripture keeps us connected like a branch to the vine.
reflectionQuestions: How consistently do you read the Bible?
What in your schedule must change to meet with God daily?

days.title: What does faith look like?
days.summary: Four friends lower a paralyzed man through a roof; faith shows up in loving action.
reflectionQuestions: What do your actions say about faith?
Who needs Jesus, and how could you bring them closer?

days.title: You don't have to clean up first
days.summary: Jesus eats with tax collectors and sinners, meeting people in their mess.
reflectionQuestions: Is a mess keeping you from Jesus?
How can you reach people in the middle of their mess?

days.title: What is the Sabbath and why does it matter?
days.summary: The Sabbath is a gift of rest and trust in God, not a list of rules.
reflectionQuestions: What does Sabbath look like for you?
When do you feel closest to God, and how can you make room for it weekly?

days.title: How to do life with others like Jesus did
days.summary: Jesus chose imperfect disciples: we can't do life alone, people will let us down, and Jesus uses anyone.
reflectionQuestions: Who do you lean on and celebrate with?
Is there someone you need to forgive or ask forgiveness from?
Who needs to hear the gospel from you this week?

days.title: Is your top commitment to Jesus?
days.summary: Jesus asks for commitment, not perfection, and He should come first.
reflectionQuestions: How committed are you to Jesus (1-10)?
What most influences your decisions, and where does Jesus rank?
What step will make Jesus your top priority?

days.title: Are you growing good soil?
days.summary: The parable of the sower: faith grows when rooted in God's Word and people, with weeds removed.
reflectionQuestions: Is your life planted in good soil?
What weeds need pulling this week?
Who supports you—should you join a group or team?

days.title: Your story is powerful and important
days.summary: Jesus taught in parables; our story of meeting Him helps reach others.
reflectionQuestions: What is your story of meeting Jesus?
How could Jesus use it?
Who could you share it with today?

days.title: How to combat fear with faith
days.summary: The disciples panic while Jesus sleeps in the storm; fear forgets His power.
reflectionQuestions: What are you afraid of, and how has it shaped you?
Where do your words and actions about Jesus not match?
How can God guide you through your current storm?

days.title: How has Jesus changed your whole life?
days.summary: The freed man tells everyone what Jesus did; a changed life leads others to Him.
reflectionQuestions: How has your life changed since following Jesus?
Who influenced your decision to follow Him?
Who needs Jesus, and how can you help?

days.title: Why your faith is important
days.summary: Jairus's daughter and the bleeding woman show God honors faith, even after painful experiences.
reflectionQuestions: Where do you need to trust God right now?
How has God honored your faith before?
Do you need to talk with someone about a struggle?

days.title: How to believe even when it's hard to see
days.summary: Jesus's hometown doubts Him; faith trusts before it sees.
reflectionQuestions: Are you waiting for proof before obeying God?
When have you taken a leap of faith, and what did you learn?

days.title: What to do when you face an impossible task
days.summary: Faced with feeding 5,000, the disciples despair; the answer is to bring it to Jesus.
reflectionQuestions: What are you most afraid of right now?
What can you learn from the disciples about bringing fears to Jesus?
When has Jesus brought you through the impossible?

days.title: Don't let distraction stop you from seeing the miracle
days.summary: Focused on the storm, the disciples nearly miss Jesus walking toward them.
reflectionQuestions: When has a storm distracted you from Jesus?
How can you prepare to notice miracles in hard seasons?
Which past miracles can you remember and celebrate?

days.title: Life with Jesus is more than a list of rules
days.summary: Pharisaic rule-keeping is contrasted with faith built on relationship and love.
reflectionQuestions: Are you motivated by rules or by following a person?
Where do Christians today repeat the Pharisees' mistakes?
What are you allowing to shape your heart?

days.title: Are your beliefs based on experience?
days.summary: Knowing Jesus personally gives weight to what we say about Him.
reflectionQuestions: How has Jesus changed you?
Who can you tell about that change?

days.title: When it's time to stop asking for a sign
days.summary: After feeding 4,000, Jesus refuses a sign; asking for signs can mask unwillingness to obey.
reflectionQuestions: How has God shown Himself faithful recently?
Are you delaying a next step while waiting for proof?

days.title: Sometimes, saying no is the best yes
days.summary: Following Jesus means denying ourselves, and the joy is worth the cost.
reflectionQuestions: Who do you say Jesus is?
What keeps you from Jesus?
Who needs hope, and how will you share it?

days.title: What happens when you go to God in prayer
days.summary: The disciples' failure to drive out a demon shows prayer is our connection to God's power.
reflectionQuestions: Have you asked God for help where you feel called but see no progress?
Where have you seen growth recently?
What is your next step with Jesus?

days.title: You are a vital part of the church family
days.summary: Every believer contributes to the church's mission by serving others.
reflectionQuestions: How can you meet someone's need today?
What are your gifts, and how might God use them?
Are you serving yet—what's your next step?

days.title: What Jesus said you should do with sin
days.summary: Sin should be cut out completely, not managed, because our lives influence others.
reflectionQuestions: What sin threatens your life, and how will you remove it?
Does your lifestyle draw people toward Jesus?
What would a trusted friend say needs to change?

days.title: Who do you lean on the most?
days.summary: Self-reliance pushes God out; we must come to Him with childlike trust.
reflectionQuestions: How self-reliant are you?
When did you last serve someone expecting nothing back?

days.title: How to know what you really value
days.summary: The rich young man walks away because his possessions mattered more than Jesus.
reflectionQuestions: What do you spend your time and money on—is anything above Jesus?
Are you tithing, and how has it affected your trust in God?
Have you put your trust in Jesus?

days.title: Tired of not getting your way?
days.summary: Prayer is less about getting what we ask and more about being shaped so our desires match God's.
reflectionQuestions: What would you ask God for if you could ask anything?
Do your requests reflect God's priorities?
How can you spend more time with God this week?

days.title: You have a brand, but do you know what it is?
days.summary: Like the coin bearing Caesar's image, we bear God's image and belong to Him.
reflectionQuestions: Where does your identity come from?
What area aren't you comfortable giving God control of?
What does your life say about God's character?

days.title: The greatest of all the commandments is love
days.summary: Jesus sums up the law as loving God and loving others, which matters more than ritual.
reflectionQuestions: What does loving God with heart, mind and soul look like?
How can you love a coworker, classmate or neighbor this week?
How does remembering your past help you love hard-to-love people?

days.title: It's OK to want to be blessed
days.summary: The widow who gave everything shows that surrender leads to God's reward.
reflectionQuestions: Do you believe God rewards those who seek Him?
What area do you want God to move in, and how can you surrender it?
Do you trust Him enough to give up what He asks?

days.title: How to survive the end of the world
days.summary: Peace, the Holy Spirit, perseverance and Scripture equip believers; the warnings shape how we live now.
reflectionQuestions: Do the end times make you uneasy?
Who is Jesus to you, and how does that shape daily life?
How do the Spirit and Scripture help you live now?

days.title: You're one of the bad guys
days.summary: Judas's betrayal mirrors our own selfish sin, in contrast to the woman who gave all she had to Jesus.
reflectionQuestions: Where do you struggle to believe Jesus has your best in mind?
Where have you experienced God's unconditional love?
When have you settled for less than God's best?

days.title: Why communion is a powerful symbol of our faith
days.summary: Communion remembers Jesus's sacrifice and the new covenant it began.
reflectionQuestions: Where were you when you first trusted Jesus?
How does communion remind you of His sacrifice?
How can you show gratitude for salvation this week?

days.title: When you are weak, Jesus makes you strong
days.summary: The disciples fail in Gethsemane; our weaknesses are where Jesus's strength shows.
reflectionQuestions: What is your greatest weakness, and how could God use it?
Where do you need Jesus to be your strength?
When has God carried you through being overwhelmed?

days.title: Are you scared of sharing your faith?
days.summary: Peter follows at a distance after the arrest; it's not too late to live and speak openly for Jesus.
reflectionQuestions: Do your actions change depending on who's around?
What do you fear about declaring your faith?
What needs to change so you proclaim Jesus rather than please people?

days.title: Does fear drive you to deny Jesus?
days.summary: Peter's denial comes from fear of others; Jesus welcomes us back when we fall.
reflectionQuestions: Are you denying Jesus in any area, and what fear drives it?
What support helps you face those fears?

days.title: You don't have to make everyone happy
days.summary: Pilate caves to the crowd; security comes from God's approval, not people-pleasing.
reflectionQuestions: Do you feel a need to please others, and why?
How can you focus on God's plan over others' opinions?
Where has people-pleasing caused harm in your life?

days.title: You are not alone in your suffering
days.summary: Jesus's cry on the cross shows He understands suffering and God is with us in ours.
reflectionQuestions: Have you opened up to anyone about your problems?
Where do you feel abandoned—can you tell Jesus now?
What decision do you need the Spirit's guidance on?

days.title: Some things are too important to worry about fitting in
days.summary: Joseph of Arimathea steps out openly to ask for Jesus's body, putting faith above fitting in.
reflectionQuestions: How important is fitting in to you (1-10)?
Have you compromised your faith to fit in?
Where can you share your faith boldly?

days.title: What the resurrection did for you
days.summary: The resurrection brings believers forgiveness, focus and a future.
reflectionQuestions: When did you last thank Jesus for your salvation?
How is your future different because Jesus is alive?
Does your focus need to change?
